question_text: Mara is a city planning officer whose brother owns a construction company that recently bid on a city infrastructure project. Mara was not part of the bidding committee, but she has access to the sealed bids. Which of the following best describes a conflict of interest under RA 6713?

options.text: Mara's brother bidding on a project is automatically a conflict of interest regardless of Mara's role.
A conflict of interest exists only if Mara actually uses her access to influence the bidding outcome.
A conflict of interest arises because Mara's family relationship and her position could compromise her objectivity, even if she does not act on it.
There is no conflict of interest because Mara is not on the bidding committee.
